reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
convert an IN subquery to a semi-join

optimized_sql:
WITH date_bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT min(d_date_sk) AS min_date_sk,
           max(d_date_sk) AS max_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
store_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk
        FROM store_sales ss
        WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT min_date_sk FROM date_bounds) AND (SELECT max_date_sk FROM date_bounds)
        GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    ) sp
    JOIN date_dim dd ON sp.date_sk = dd.d_date_sk AND dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = sp.customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
),
catalog_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT min_date_sk FROM date_bounds) AND (SELECT max_date_sk FROM date_bounds)
        GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    ) cp
    JOIN date_dim dd ON cp.date_sk = dd.d_date_sk AND dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = cp.customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
),
web_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk
        FROM web_sales ws
        WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT min_date_sk FROM date_bounds) AND (SELECT max_date_sk FROM date_bounds)
        GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    ) wp
    JOIN date_dim dd ON wp.date_sk = dd.d_date_sk AND dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = wp.customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, dd.d_date
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_names
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_names
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_names
) hot_cust
LIMIT 100
